meta.title: Gabee — Learn code, typing, words and maths, FR/EN
meta.description: Gabee is a bilingual learning tool for 6-10 year-olds: vocabulary, math, coding logic, keyboard typing — in French and English.
meta.ogDescription: Vocabulary, math, first steps in coding and keyboard typing. In French and English. Free, up to 3 children.

hero.sub: Gabee is a learning tool for 6-10 year-olds: vocabulary, math, coding logic, keyboard typing — in French and English.

modules.below: Your child strengthens their skills in both languages.

sessions.sub: Small moments of play, designed for real learning.

items.cap: They type the word, letter by letter.
They complete the sentence with the right word.
They program the bee to the flower.

step1.title: Sign up & add your kids
step1.body: Create your account. Add your kids — first name, age, what you'd like them to focus on.

step2.title: Set up Gabee on the family device, once
step2.body: Set up Gabee once on the home computer or tablet. After that, your kids open it, pick their profile, and play. No password for them.

step3.title: Stay close to their day
step3.body: Each day, a short email tells you what your kids have been doing. You stay close to their learning, two minutes at a time.

step4.title: Leave them a word
step4.body: A short message, anytime. At their next session, your child will see: "Papa left you a note." They read it, and it makes their day.

skills.title: Skills for today and tomorrow
skills.body: Vocabulary and math, but also first steps in coding and keyboard typing. Your child builds the foundational skills that will help them navigate the modern world.

bilingual.title: Truly bilingual, at their own pace
bilingual.body: At each session, your child picks their language. In French or English, they actually learn in both.

visibility.title: You see what's happening
visibility.body: Which module they prefer, where they progress, where they get stuck, how long they play — and in which language. No badges cheering them for nothing: real information for you.

respect.title: Designed with respect
respect.body: Sensible session lengths, no ads, no in-app purchases. The time your child spends here serves their learning.

faq.a1: Typically 6-10 years old. The progression adapts to the child's level.
faq.a2: Both. Your child picks the language at the start of each session.
faq.a3: Yes, the kid app works entirely offline. Data syncs when the connection comes back.
faq.a4: Gabee has built-in session caps and time tracking in the parent dashboard.
faq.q5: How do I delete my data?
faq.a5: One button in Settings → Delete account. Everything is wiped within 30 days.
faq.a6: Today, Gabee is free. We'll be transparent if anything ever changes.
faq.a7: Yes — invite the other parent by email from your settings.
faq.a8: You (and your co-parent if invited). Nobody else — no advertisers, no third parties.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: How Gabee collects, uses and protects parents' and children's data. Proxia Digital is the data controller under law 2024/017.
framework: Law No. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 — the primary framework. Article 5 defines personal data; Article 6 et seq. lay out the principles ("prior, free, informed, specific and unambiguous consent").
Minors' provision (Art. 6+): "A minor under 18's consent is valid only if supported by that of their parents or legal representative."
Article 54 et seq. — sanctions (administrative up to 100M FCFA, civil, penal). Compliance deadline: 23 June 2026.
Law No. 2023/007 (online child-protection charter) and law No. 2010/012 (cybersecurity) also inform this policy.

sections.b: Proxia Digital, Akwa, Douala, Cameroon; the data controller under law 2024/017; contact for data-protection questions.

Parent: email, first name, last name, country, language, hashed password, login metadata. Child: first name, birthday (derived age), avatar choice, optional school level + objectives, language picked each session. Learning data: module, level, lesson, language, duration, answers, hints, keystrokes, classification. Pairing: device label, last activity, refresh-token reference.

When your child uses Gabee we collect technical information about their device: IP address, a random device identifier, operating system & browser (and device model where available), screen size & pixel density, time zone, app language & version, and install type (installed app vs browser tab). We use it to keep accounts safe (anti-abuse), diagnose problems you report, understand device and usage patterns in aggregate, and manage the devices linked to your family — never to profile a child, never sold, never for advertising, never shared with third parties. We do not collect precise location, contacts, photos, microphone/camera, or browsing outside Gabee. Retention: the raw IP recorded against a device is kept 90 days then automatically deleted by a daily job; other device fields are kept while the device record exists and removed when the account is deleted; sign-in security logs (the address of each sign-in, sign-up and password reset) are kept for 5 years to investigate account misuse. Raw IP addresses are visible only to senior administrators and are never written to ordinary logs. Stored in the EU; IP addresses are never sent to any outside service, including for location lookup.
Provide the service (sync across devices); show the parent what their child is doing; improve content (anonymized); operational (debugging and security logs).
Parental consent for the child's data — the basis under Gabee's model, revocable at any time. Contract for the parent's own data. Legitimate interest for security logs and abuse prevention.

Named sub-processors: Supabase (database + auth, EU region); Mailgun (email, US); Sentry (error reporting, US — technical data only, no personal data). Never shared with advertisers, data brokers or social platforms. Mailgun and Sentry entail a US transfer, covered by documented safeguards.
When a parent invites a co-parent, the invitee gains access to the shared kids' data. Each parent provides their own consent at signup.

Active accounts: data retained while active. Deletion: 30-day soft-delete (recoverable), then hard-delete. Inactive accounts: after 24 months without login, an email warning then deletion. Aggregated analytics (not linked to any person) may be retained indefinitely.

Access, rectification, erasure ("right to be forgotten"), portability, objection / restriction, and the right to lodge a complaint with the Cameroon authority. For minors, these rights are exercised by the parent or legal representative.
HTTPS everywhere (HSTS on the .app domain); hashed passwords; database encryption at rest; access controls; structured logging; incident-response plan and breach notification per law 2024/017.
Supabase is hosted in the EU; Mailgun and Sentry entail a US transfer; safeguards (contractual clauses, sub-processor commitments) documented in this policy.
Only essential cookies (NEXT_LOCALE for language, session cookie for auth). No consent banner — no non-essential cookies are set.
Notice via email and an in-app banner on next sign-in for material changes, which trigger renewed consent.
Proxia Digital, Akwa, Douala, Cameroon; phone +237 691980190; email hello@gabee.app; Data Protection Officer (DPO): Valentine Nguemne (hello@gabee.app).
Effective date: 1 July 2026.
